deduplication.rule: Original, patch, localization and mobile are related editions/artifacts; EXCELLENT contains genuinely added story material and must be audited separately.
Six OAV; DVDPG1/2/3 reuse episodes1–2/3–4/5–6. Compilation and complete releases do not add six more stories.
Two OAV; complete DVD/Blu-ray releases are editions of that pair.
12-volume,6-volume Complete and2-volume complete are grouped as one editorial family; exact internal correspondence and differences between standard/adult editions remain uninspected.
4-volume editions and2-volume Complete are grouped as one editorial family; no multiplication of characters/costumes from volume counts.

importantDistinctions: LS is the2009 PC prequel title; Zero/Rei/零 is the2010 OAV title. Do not label the2009 PC game Discipline Zero on the strength of a secondary mistranslation.

An official commercial color-comic branch exists; film-comic classification is probable from one indexed block but has not been independently reverified. That does not establish a separate originally drawn manga series or validate an unsourced plot claim from a fan wiki.
Visual Works and Cover Artbook are unresolved community English labels; do not create two extra official books without publisher/ISBN/colophon evidence.
Heartwork, Bible Black, Starless and other Seishoujo titles are not merged into the Discipline continuity simply because the creator is shared.
Characters described as anime/Zero-specific are not matched to anonymous characters in another medium without direct evidence.
